data.action: 盘腿坐在礁石上，剑横在膝上
data.description: 【斯卡蒂 · 礁石小憩】涨潮时分孤立于海中央的巨大平坦礁石上，斯卡蒂赤足盘腿而坐，巨剑平横在修长的大腿上，任由冰凉的海水漫过脚踝。她微微扬起下颌——「在海里游累的时候，我总是喜欢像这样坐在礁石上晒干头发。博士，坐到我身边来，这块礁石很平整。」
data.promptProse: Skadi sits barefoot and cross-legged on a broad reef as the afternoon tide rises, her greatsword resting horizontally across her lap. Her cropped jacket lies beside her black-and-red bodysuit. Foam reaches her ankles; beyond the rock, successive swells lead toward the open horizon. Bright sea light picks out her drying silver hair and blade edge, with blue reflected light beneath her knees.
data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 礁石小憩
